english: Ôst is standing at a street corner. Behind him, a large crate of milk bottles.
Now leave! I do not speak with Cleric!
Go Cleric. I do not speak with you.
You're just hanging out down here?
Try harder. You can do this!
You see him stop his growling. He thinks to himself. Something.
But then the kobold turns around and starts picking up bottles.
The kobold roots around in the crate, and then glances at you with a deep unflinching frown (that looks exactly like all his other expressions).
You TAKE milk. That is not working with MILK RUN!
Since you TAKE, you will have to WORK.
He hands them to you, one by one.
You are now milk delivery human. You are on the MILK RUN.
Each bottle is special. Very expensive.
You must deliver it to rich people. Make them buy.
The price is... four thousand. Crown.
After you sell them all, you come to me. On election day. That is when we count money.
You sell all, you get twenty thousand crown. That is math.
On election day, you pay me ten thousand crown. That is recoup.
Is cleric listening? Is cleric awake?!
Recoup. I get ten. You get ten.
What happens if I don't sell them all?
Who do I sell it to?
No. I don't want to do this. (Don't fall for it.)
Expensive milk. Good milk. If Cleric cannot sell, Cleric pays. Ten thousand.
Stupid human. Rich human. Milk lover. Cow fucker.
Find and sell. Easy. Even Cleric can do.
Eh. Might be worth it in the end.
Cleric come talk on election day.
You do whatever you want, Cleric. But please- don't even think about asking me to buy one.
You should probably try to find some humans! They love milk.
Go away. I will not talk to Cleric.
Seems like he's not in the mood to talk.
That's a big word for a little green guy.
Snell glances at you, then shrugs.
Do as wish. If cleric does, cleric will pay.
But it is milk. It is delicious.
I get from producer. Then transport. Then sell.
It is Milk Run. It is big profit.
You are not going to be able to sell any of this milk.
Simply drink it. You will be your own customer.
Well, uh... there's probably some way for you to sell these. Right?
Come speak after election. Money will be collected then!
